messages:
Mai Tran: Quick heads-up — want to flip the kv-prefetch feature flag for continuous-batching optimizations tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: reduce cold-KV misses and lower p95 token latency for medium-length requests. Canary plan below, need :eyes: from oncall + infra.

Sanjay Patel: SGTM. Can you drop the canary audience and rollback guardrails here? Also add the perf test plan.

Mai Tran: Canary audience = 2% of traffic (random sampling by customer_id hash). Rollout steps: 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% over ~4h windows if guardrails pass. Guardrails: error rate delta <= +1%, p95 latency delta <= +50ms, cache-hit improvement >= +5% or no regression in QPS. Abort if any of these fail.

Lee (oncall): I can monitor. Put me at 09:00 — I'll have PagerDuty ready. Which dashboards?

Mai Tran: @Lee (oncall) — primary dashboard: grafana/redwood/kv-prefetch-overview (p95/p99, error-rate, cache hit rate, avg tokens/sec). Also link to synthetic load job: ci/perf/kv_prefetch_canary (run 30m pre-flip).

Alex M: For the actual flip, do we use LaunchDarkly or the internal ff service? I can run the toggle but want the curl snippet to be sure.

Mai Tran: internal ff service. Command we'll use (run from ops network):

Alex M: ```
# enable 2% audience
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/kv_prefetch/audience 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"percent":2, "reason":"canary 2026-03-18"}'
```

deploy-bot: scheduled roll command received: kv_prefetch audit=canary actor=alexm start=1776620400 audience=2%

Sanjay Patel: Add these regression checks to telemetry alerting:
- short-circuit alert if 5xx rate increases by +0.5% absolute
- p95 latency bump > 50ms over baseline (5m window)
- cache hit-rate drop > 3%
Set alerts to page on breach.

telemetry-bot: alerts configured: 5xx-rate-increase / p95-latency-regression / kv-hit-rate-drop. Notification channels: #eng-oncall, pager duty.

Lee (oncall): I'll run the synthetic load at 08:30 PT and confirm baseline. If all green, flip at 09:00 PT. If any alert fires, we rollback to previous audience 0% and run postmortem. Who executes rollback?

Mai Tran: Alex M will execute rollback (same endpoint, set percent=0). Alex, can you be on-call for the first 30m after flip?

Alex M: Yep. I'll be online 08:45-10:00 PT. Rollback command: ```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/kv_prefetch/audience -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"percent":0, "reason":"rollback - triggered by alert"}'
```

Sanjay Patel: Also add a short smoke test: run 10 sample requests hitting long prefix sequences and verify KV cache hits >= baseline. If smoke fails, rollback immediately.

Mai Tran: Noted. Post-rollout validation: run hourly sampling against production logs to ensure token cost drops and no hallucination/regression on structured outputs for the top-10 callers. If any quality regression > 0.2% failure rate, we pause and investigate.

Lee (oncall): Understood. I'll annotate runbook with these steps. Quick checklist for tomorrow: 08:30 baseline perf run (Lee), 08:45 ops token/gates ready (Alex), 09:00 flip to 2% (Alex), watch 30m then step to 10% if green, telemetry bot to page if thresholds breached.

Mai Tran: Thanks everyone. I'll post the final canary start time in #eng-platform 30m before flip. Please react with :thumbsup: if you approve.

Alex M: :thumbsup:

Sanjay Patel: :thumbsup:

Lee (oncall): :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: action-log: user=alexm event=audience_set flag=kv_prefetch percent=2 time=1776620400
